question: Which saved hotels for ZIP 02108 can provide 2 rooms from October 10 through checkout October 13, 2026, and what is the simulated total cost?
out_of_coverage_question: Which saved hotels can provide 1 room from November 1 through checkout November 3, 2026?
sql: SELECT h.provider_place_id, h.hotel_name, h.address, '02108' AS searched_zip, '2026-10-10' AS check_in, '2026-10-13' AS checkout, 2 AS requested_rooms, COUNT(DISTINCT n.night_date) AS stay_nights, MIN(n.rooms_available) AS minimum_rooms_available, SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents) * 2 AS total_cost_cents FROM saved_hotels AS h JOIN demo_hotel_nights AS n ON n.saved_hotel_id = h.saved_hotel_id WHERE n.night_date >= '2026-10-10' AND n.night_date < '2026-10-13' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_hotel_zips AS z WHERE z.saved_hotel_id = h.saved_hotel_id AND z.searched_zip = '02108') GROUP BY h.saved_hotel_id, h.provider_place_id, h.hotel_name, h.address HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.night_date) = 3 AND MIN(n.rooms_available) >= 2 ORDER BY total_cost_cents, h.provider_place_id LIMIT 50
expected_answer: Eligible Inn can provide 2 rooms for the three included nights from October 10 through October 12 for 67000 cents ($670.00) in simulated classroom data. The October 13 checkout date is excluded; these values are not live prices, real inventory, or booking information.
